title: Increase in new HIV-1 infections among people who inject drugs: retrospective analysis of a potential transmission cluster in Bonn
summary:
In the clinical setting, several new HIV diagnoses among people who inject drugs (PWID) were identified at the study center over a five-year period. This raises the question of whether there is an epidemiological link in the sense of a local transmission cluster. Molecular phylogenetic analyses of HIV sequences represent an established tool for investigating potential transmission links.

The present study therefore aims to analyze the clinical, epidemiological, and molecular characteristics of these cases.
